pr.title: dpi-h-ra: draw the remaining figures from the ArchiMate model
pr.body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"litlfred"} -->
_Requested by **litlfred** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9?thread=cmsg_017WNUkNK8kdDziPK58Pv6G9UepaMqGRybGWQGzxmMg5KD)_

Refs #217.

This PR is stacked on `claude/poster-theme-preview`, which pins cat-harness-tools to the poster theme branch for previews only. Once cat-harness-tools#1294 merges, it gets rebased onto `main`. It is a content change, so it waits for the owner's OK before merging.

## What changes
Each figure block now points to an SVG that `archimate-blocks` draws from a model view. The old PNG stays in `meta.source.file`.

| Figure | Draft image | View |
|---|---|---|
| 2.3 design principles | image4 | new: 10 Principle elements named after the §2.3 headings |
| 3.1 realisation chain | image18 | new |
| 3.3 single goal | image21 | existing (0.2.0-draft.3) |
| 3.4 TPHR layered | image20 | existing (0.2.0-draft.3) |
| Q&CC sub-goal | image22 | existing (0.2.0-draft.3) |
| 3.4.1 SGI | image23 | new; numbered IGs and apps are marked `illustrative=true` |
| 3.7.1 / 3.7.2 | image28/29 | existing (0.2.0), same as draft #207 |
| A.1 | image30 | new view reusing the Metadata Registry Governance elements. Drops the `<MD>` working prefixes (old names kept as `formerName`) and adds the tool links that the Appendix F text describes |

The new views come from `tools/archimate-dth/dpi_h_figures.py` through `add_views.py`, which now supports `EXISTING_RELATIONS` and a `gap` layout node. A second run adds nothing.

Skipped because they come from outside sources: Fig 1, and Figs 3.4.2 and 3.4.3. Left alone: Fig 3.2 and the DPI-H layers figure, which belong to the poster theme work.

## Checks
- `archimate-blocks --check` passes: 11 blocks and SVGs match the data.
- `check-archimate` passes.
- `stage-local` passes: 0 unresolved links. Preview: https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/STAGING/claude-remaining-figures-computable/en/dpi-h-ra/index.html
